lead: Cinematic sci-fi war film still, charred ruins and ember light, fire red and cold blue.
notes: Mood-only mini images for EradicationWars.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen EradicationWars-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish EradicationWars-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: sector
images.prompt: A huge ring-shaped jumpgate glowing in space near a colonized planet, freighters lined up to pass through.

images.name: nations
images.prompt: Two identical armies of giant robots facing each other across a ruined plain, one painted red, one painted blue.

images.name: battle
images.prompt: Armored robots leaping between broken towers of a burning industrial city, tracer fire everywhere.

images.name: region
images.prompt: Crowds of civilians running toward a huge concrete shelter entrance as war machines fight on the horizon.

images.name: sleeper
images.prompt: A colossal sleeper ship rising from a fortified city into a dark sky, escort ships around it.

images.name: hangar
images.prompt: A pilot resting on a bench in a quiet mecha hangar between battles, a giant robot standing behind.

images.name: entry
images.prompt: An armored robot dropping from the sky on a detachable booster rocket, plates falling away, flames.

images.name: fortress
images.prompt: A gigantic tracked land fortress covered in cannon turrets rolling through smoke, tiny robots around it.

images.name: sky
images.prompt: Two fleets of battleships firing at each other in a burning sky above a battlefield, one ship exploding.

images.name: thrown
images.prompt: A huge robot rifle spinning through the air across a ruined battlefield, debris and smoke.
